items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: And that gun inside, Tyra was sitting with us. What did he play? He played sax, and I tried to teach him the clarinet

ctx.x: I heard about, they had a place up there that was so tough, they put the band behind Chicken Wire. Yeah, oh that was, it was in the Audubon Park I believe.

Some place, I don't know, I'm kind of a little. Yeah. And then there was the Golden Dragon on St. Anne Street. Uh, the Slitko on piano, George Slitko, I haven't seen him for a long time. I think he was in California, he played a fine piano. Uh huh. And uh, we'll see Joe Stevens and myself, the three asses we used to call ourselves. Uh huh. And you know how we lost that, John? Uh huh. Well they had some girl around 18 years old, I was around 18 myself. Uh huh. And uh, they had some fine looking gal there, she sat…

Well, he wanted to help you. He's a nice fellow Charlie. Yeah, yeah, he was one of the best guys I've ever known. I never did know Henry Raymond, but he made some nice records with Detroit. Yeah. Yeah. Let me fix us another drink. I'll have a take for about a while.
